notes.title: 2.27 Language update
notes.notes:
Due to feedback from many foreign players who are eager to play our game but face difficulties with the lack of an English version, we have spent some time carefully preparing localised translations to ensure that native English speakers can enjoy the game without barriers.
Please enjoy the game.

notes.title: 1.15 Update
notes.notes:
1. The roadmap mode has been updated; the clear game limit has been removed. Players can now access the roadmap in their first playthrough and start from any unlocked nodes.
2. The roadmap now features more stunning effects.
3. Fixed several known issues of UI.

notes.title: 1.13 Update
notes.notes:
1. Optimize existing UI bugs.
2. Fix the bug that prevents achievements from being completed.

notes.title: 1.10 Bug fix
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the execution logic of the achievement system
2. Fixed the currently known issue of missing text dialogue
3. Fixed the currently known audio loss issue
4. Optimized the format of the narration
5. Optimized the script.
